interfaces.description: List of network interface names (e.g., ['eth0', 'wlan0']) to bind the AHCP server to. Leave empty to use default routing.

log_level.description: Verbosity level for server logs. Options: debug, info, notice, warning, error, crit, alert, emerg.

mode.description: Server operation mode: 'server' (active responder), 'auto' (detect and act as needed), or 'none' (disable AHCP). Enum: server, client, forwarder.

pool_prefix.description: IPv6 prefix (in CIDR notation) to delegate to clients for address configuration and prefix delegation.

prefix_lifetime.description: Lifetime (in seconds) for delegated IPv6 prefixes. Clients must reconfirm before expiration.

prefix_preferred_lifetime.description: Preferred lifetime (in seconds) for delegated prefixes — time before deprecation.

address_ranges.description: Static IPv6 address ranges assigned to specific clients or subnets. Each entry defines a start–end range for address allocation.

dns_servers.description: List of IPv6 or IPv4 addresses of DNS servers to provide to clients via AHCP options.

ntp_servers.description: List of hostnames or IP addresses of NTP servers to provide to clients for time synchronization.

domain_search.description: List of DNS search domains (e.g., ['home.lan', 'corp.example.com']) for client DNS resolution.

lease_file.description: Path to the file where AHCP stores current lease information for persistence across restarts.

ipv4_fallback.description: Behavior for IPv4 fallback: 'auto' (enable IPv4 if IPv6 unavailable), 'off' (IPv6 only).
